description: Na₂BaO₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmc2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.34 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent BaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with three equivalent BaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.45 Å. Ba is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted BaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent BaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent BaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.72-2.75 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na and three equivalent Ba atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OBa₃Na₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-63°. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and two equivalent Ba atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OBa₂Na₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-54°.
